name: Unequal routes
summary: Compact medium wells on one route; a shallow approach to deep wells on the other.
rules: Five layers in the two starting 2×2 corners.
A deep 3×2 expansion at the northeast, rotated to the southwest.
Add a compact eight-cell shelf of four-layer wells on each player’s near flank.
Lower eight approach cells on the other flank to two layers; rotate both features.
